name: dsh-token-frugal
description: Cut the input-token cost of long Harness sessions: structure-aware tool-output compression on tools/post-execute and per-agent tool-catalogue visibility on agent/created.

meta.title: Token Frugal
meta.description: Compresses tool output at the source and trims the tool catalogue, with a measurement script that reports the token and cache-hit-rate effect.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check lib/compress.js && node --check lib/estimate.js && node --check lib/defaults.js && node --check tools/measure-tokens.mjs && node --check test/load-check.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run load-check
